    name: str
    is_open_monday: bool
    monday_hours: str

monday_open_info = [
    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Given the following opening hours for the restaurant '{name}': '{opening_hours[name]}', determine if the restaurant is open on Mondays. If open, extract the Monday hours. Return the restaurant name, whether it is open on Monday, and the Monday hours.",
        MondayOpenModel
    )
    for name in affordable_restaurants
]

    name: str
    rating: float
    review_summary: str

        f"Given the following rating and reviews for the restaurant '{name}': '{ratings_reviews[name]}', extract the overall rating as a float and a brief review summary. Return the restaurant name, rating, and review summary.",
        RatingModel
    )
    for name in open_on_monday
]

# Step 7: Gather all required info for the best restaurant

)
